## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature / analysis
- [ ] Docs / design
- [ ] Refactor / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check src` passes
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] No data dumps, build artifacts, or secrets committed
- [ ] Docs updated (README / DESIGN.md) if needed
- [ ] Change respects the educational, non-clinical framing

## Notes

Anything reviewers should know (screenshots, trade-offs, follow-ups).
